Switch.Name: Enable Status HUD Sorting
Switch.Hint: When enabled, the status effects labels will also be shown and an opinionated sorting will take place

SortingType.Name: Status effects sorting
SortingType.Hint: Fill by rows (left → right) or by columns (top → bottom)

NumberColumns.Name: Number of columns
NumberColumns.Hint: Divide the HUD status effects into this number of columns

ScaleEnabled.Name: Enable HUD scaling
ScaleEnabled.Hint: Apply the HUD scale percentage and compensate for scene zoom and grid pixel size. Disable to use the default HUD size without compensation.

Scale.Name: HUD scale
Scale.Hint: Scale the Assign Status Effects HUD as a percentage of its default size

ClearEffects.Name: Show Clear effects button
ClearEffects.Hint: D&D 5e: remove actor-owned effects with configured statuses and custom effects listed in the HUD, including disabled effects and all stacks. Falling and item-owned effects are not removed. Clearing is not limited by the search filter.
ClearEffects.Tooltip: Clear status-effect copies and levels, plus custom HUD effects, regardless of the search filter. Falling is managed by the system and is not cleared.
ClearEffects.Error: Could not clear effects. See the console for details.

Filter.Name: Enable status filter
Filter.Hint: Show a search field above status effects to filter by name or status id

BASES.IncompatibleSystemError: Bugbear's Assign Status Effects Sorter is not compatible with your system and the Assign Status Effects HUD changes have been disabled. Disabling the module is recommended!
